b2b_fpr_cal.note: denominator is CONSTRUCTED probe observations (50319 p3 probes across the frame = 3 x 16,773), NOT independent benign executions.  Wilson treats them as exchangeable probes; cluster awareness is the p3-null construction itself.

note: Descriptive Wilson intervals (execution-level binomial) are kept SEPARATE from the cluster-bootstrap uncertainty estimates.  The excess CI is the two-proportion normal approximation on the LEP-vs-benign difference.
